fix(memkernel-0-3): ask() on documents uses the indexed chunks for the local reasoner

The local reasoner re-chunked and re-embedded a document's whole body on
every ask() although its chunks were already embedded and BM25-indexed at
retain time. MemoryService.ask now hands the built-in reasoner the best
indexed chunks from DocumentStorePort.search (ask_top_k of them), which
becomes a hybrid search (dense + BM25, RRF-fused, exact-term ties win)
restricted to that document's chunk ids. An external reasoner keeps
receiving the whole body because RLM Studio retrieves on its own; the
fallback path after an external failure uses the indexed chunks too.
build_service() passes local_reasoner=not external. The port's search()
is now the live retrieval step rather than an unused method.
EOF
